precommit.scope: Source, 4/14/22 split, RPT8 response, three arms, ridge model, metrics, and gates were sealed before any per-cell summary CSV value was read.
precommit.pilotBoundary: Four zero-weight cells fixed exact column, unit, RPT-row, and GITT pulse mappings before development or target values were read.

selection.reason: RC52 failed under source transfer because early electrical curves lacked a transportable hidden-state coordinate. RC53 tests whether beginning-of-life electrode-resolved and pulse-resistance diagnostics add that coordinate under complete usage-regime holdout.
selection.source: 40 LG M50T 21700 cells from Imperial College London, 15 operating conditions, official Zenodo record 10637534.

newlyVerifiedFacts: The official metadata lists 40 cells and the five archives contain exactly 40 matching Performance Summary files.
All 40 cells contain RPT0 and RPT8 C/10 capacity; the primary paper identifies RPT8 as the last common diagnostic horizon.
The response is direct RPT8/RPT0 C/10 capacity retention. It is not an EOL or lifetime label because some cells stopped before a common EOL.
The four pilot cells passed the registered schema, unit, 25-pulse, and twelfth-pulse checks and have exactly zero model weight.
Arm A, using only imposed stress, has 6.3833 percentage-point target MdAE, 6.0053 pp MAE, 10.3257 pp maximum error, and pooled Spearman 0.4997.
Arm B adds BoL C/10 and C/2 capacity and lowers MdAE to 5.6988 pp, a 10.72% improvement, but raises maximum error to 11.2032 pp; H1 therefore fails its joint gate.
Arm C adds electrode capacities, electrode offset, and 0.1 s and 10 s GITT resistance. Its pooled Spearman rises to 0.6239, but MdAE worsens to 10.5468 pp and maximum error to 16.6462 pp.
Arm C worsens MdAE by 65.22% relative to stress-only and by 85.07% relative to capacity, so the static passport hypothesis is rejected rather than rescued by rank correlation.
Arm C's pooled rank is regime-confounded: after centering within experiments, Spearman is -0.0119; experiment-specific Spearman is -0.6571, 0.3810, and -0.2619.
Arm C underpredicts mean retention by 6.73, 9.06, and 9.74 percentage points in held experiments 2,2, 4, and 5 respectively.
Post-verdict block ablations remain poor: capacity plus DMA has MdAE 8.4496 pp, while capacity plus resistance has 6.7621 pp. Neither changes the registered verdict.
Python and dependency-free Node agree across 117 predictions, metrics, experiment metrics, and verdict comparisons with maximum absolute difference 7.82e-14.

hypotheses.reason: Stress-only misses the 1.5 pp MdAE, 0.60 Spearman, and per-experiment 2.0 pp gates.
BoL capacity improves median error by 10.72% but increases maximum error, failing the joint condition.
The static electrode/resistance passport improves pooled rank but increases median and maximum errors and fails every per-experiment error gate.
A common RPT8 response cannot establish fifth-source EOL or lifetime validation without a common EOL event and sealed EOL target cohort.

failedOrRejectedApproaches: Treating known temperature and SoC/protocol as sufficient across untrained usage regimes.
Adding initial capacity while ignoring its increased worst-case error.
Treating pooled Spearman 0.624 as evidence of cell-level ranking; within-regime rank is essentially zero.
Using a high-dimensional static BoL passport as a transferable degradation coordinate with only 14 development cells.
Interpreting electrode-fit variables as direct, unique mechanism observations rather than model-dependent diagnostic proxies.
Calling RPT8 capacity retention lifetime or EOL despite heterogeneous termination.
Post-hoc removal of the DMA or resistance block to rescue H2; both are exploratory and neither passes the original gate.

causalFinding.input: Usage descriptors plus BoL capacity, electrode-fit, and GITT resistance.
causalFinding.bottleneck: Static BoL levels mix cell susceptibility with experiment, rig, batch, and feature-extraction coordinates; they do not observe how the state responds to damage.
causalFinding.bridgeTested: If the passport were transportable, it would reduce held-regime magnitude error and preserve within-regime ranking.
causalFinding.independentQuantity: RPT8/RPT0 C/10 retention on 22 cells from three complete held experiments.
causalFinding.verdict: The bridge fails: pooled rank is between-regime structure, not within-regime cell susceptibility, and magnitude bias remains 6.7-9.7 pp.

mostPromisingPath.name: Standardized perturbation response passport
mostPromisingPath.status: A falsifiable next path supported by RC53 failure structure, not established as novel or validated.
mostPromisingPath.hypothesis: A short early change vector—RPT0 to RPT1 or RPT2 changes in LLI, LAM, electrode offset, and GITT resistance under a standardized perturbation—captures damage susceptibility more directly than static BoL levels.
mostPromisingPath.difference: The new coordinate is a response derivative under controlled damage, not a baseline manufacturing or rig coordinate. It must be combined with the future duty descriptor and evaluated hierarchically within regimes.
mostPromisingPath.minimumTest: On a new source with at least 60 cells and a common EOL definition, randomize at least three early perturbation regimes within one lot, reserve four zero-weight schema pilots, use at most eight influence-bounded calibration cells, and keep at least 30 cells plus entire duty regimes sealed. Compare stress-only, static BoL, early-change, and early-change-plus-physics arms.
mostPromisingPath.success: The early-change arm must improve common-EOL MdAPE by at least 25% over static BoL, retain within-regime Spearman at least 0.50, meet an 80% interval coverage and width gate, and remain stable when one calibration cell is removed.
mostPromisingPath.reject: Reject if improvement exists only in pooled regime means, if within-regime ranking is below 0.50, if one perturbation cell controls the result, or if degradation-mode ordering changes between accelerated and service arms.
mostPromisingPath.failureValue: Failure would show whether the missing information is not a diagnostic derivative but later path bifurcation, spatial/mechanical state, or an unobserved manufacturing variable.

structuralConnection.sharedBottleneck: UP-219, UP-233, and UP-234 all require a state coordinate that separates imposed history from latent susceptibility. Static initial observations can identify experiment means while failing cell-level transport.
structuralConnection.holdsWhen: The perturbation is standardized, diagnostics are comparable, response derivatives precede the adjudication horizon, and held regimes share the same mechanism ordering.
structuralConnection.breaksWhen: Baseline features encode batch or rig, mechanisms bifurcate after the early window, EOL semantics differ, or spatial/mechanical defects remain invisible.
structuralConnection.minimumValidation: Within-regime ranking and held-regime magnitude error must pass separately; pooled correlation is never sufficient.

workPackages.purpose: Find a source with common EOL and early repeated diagnostics.
workPackages.method: Screen official datasets for at least 60 same-lot cells, common EOL, RPT0 and RPT1/2 DMA or resistance, and condition replication.
workPackages.pass: At least 30 untouched EOL targets remain after pilots and calibration.
workPackages.fail: Do not substitute a common-horizon SOH response for EOL.

workPackages.purpose: Separate baseline coordinates from response derivatives.
workPackages.method: Randomize a standardized low-damage perturbation and freeze RPT0-to-RPTk changes in LLI, LAM, offset, and resistance before EOL labels.
workPackages.deliverable: Static and derivative feature tables with extraction hashes.
workPackages.pass: Independent extraction agrees and no target contributes to scaling.
workPackages.fail: If the perturbation changes mechanism ordering, redesign rather than extrapolate.

workPackages.purpose: Adjudicate hierarchy rather than pooled association.
workPackages.method: Report held-regime magnitude error, within-regime rank, interval coverage/width, and calibration-cell influence for all arms.
workPackages.deliverable: Cell-level predictions and regime-centered diagnostics from two implementations.
workPackages.pass: Joint registered gates pass in every eligible regime.

workPackages.purpose: Escalate sensing only when electrochemical derivatives fail.
workPackages.method: Add expansion, pressure, ultrasound, or manufacturing telemetry one modality at a time against the same sealed targets.
workPackages.pass: A modality reduces error and preserves mechanism ordering under independent replication.
workPackages.fail: Stop adding correlated proxies if conditional error does not fall.

uncertaintyBudget.control: Keep the claim at common-horizon degradation and require common EOL next.
uncertaintyBudget.stop: No RUL, warranty, or safety inference.

uncertaintyBudget.risk: DMA depends on OCV fitting and GITT on timing and contact resistance.
uncertaintyBudget.control: Freeze pulse and fit definitions; replicate extraction independently.
uncertaintyBudget.stop: Unresolved unit, pulse, or fit ambiguity stops the arm.

uncertaintyBudget.risk: Fourteen development cells support fifteen passport features only through ridge regularization.
uncertaintyBudget.control: Treat the result as a strict stress test and require larger, replicated next cohorts.
Report within-regime centered rank and per-regime error.

uncertaintyBudget.risk: Several mechanisms produce the same capacity and resistance.
uncertaintyBudget.control: Use degradation-mode ordering and independent modalities as validation axes.
uncertaintyBudget.stop: Prediction accuracy alone never identifies a unique mechanism.

failedRuns: The first full extraction stopped at Expt 5-A because its GITT folder uses 'Cell' while earlier archives use 'cell'. No result artifact was written and no cell was removed. The path match was made case-insensitive to folder capitalization without changing the registered file suffix or quantity.

The pilot initially required direct C/10 retention and the source SoH column to agree within 1e-10. Their maximum difference was 1.83e-6, so the sealed amendment kept the direct ratio and recorded a 1e-4 schema cross-check tolerance before development or target values were read.
claimBoundaries: No fifth-source lifetime or EOL validation was achieved.
No field pack, calendar life, safety failure, chemistry transfer, or fabrication experiment was performed.
No static BoL passport was validated for deployment.
The next derivative-passport proposal is unvalidated and not claimed as novel until a focused prior-art search and prospective test.
nextCycleStart: Do not tune another static model on the opened Imperial RPT8 outcomes. Search for a new source with a common EOL event, at least 60 same-lot cells, replicated usage regimes, and RPT0 plus early repeated DMA/resistance or another orthogonal diagnostic. Before EOL values are opened, preregister a standardized perturbation, four zero-weight schema pilots, at most eight influence-bounded calibration cells, at least 30 untouched EOL targets, and separate pooled, within-regime, coverage, width, and mechanism-ordering gates.
